raw_selection.reuse_stageB_geometry_rule: all non-null raw beams within 100m of each frozen cell

colocation.query_center: each raw beam's own reconstructed Earth-coordinate

predeclared_metrics: raw_beam_to_raw_beam horizontal separation between closest opposite-lineage beam pair
raw depth difference for closest opposite-lineage beam pair
per raw beam: KN192 and KNOX median depth at 25/50/100m
per lineage and radius: median absolute residual to each 2008 survey
per frozen cell: whether line18 and line32 residual ordering persists after beam-coordinate co-location

interpretation.SPATIAL_ALIASING_SUPPORTED: At primary 50m radius, both raw lineages have comparable absolute residuals to both 2008 surfaces and their opposite-lineage raw depth difference is largely mirrored by the 2008 depth difference between their own beam coordinates.
interpretation.LINE32_OUTER_BEAM_SYSTEMATIC_SUPPORTED: At primary 50m radius, line18 agrees materially better with both independent 2008 surfaces than line32 at their respective beam coordinates, so sub-cell location alone does not explain the split.
